name: search_stats
description: Search e-Stat statistical tables. Returns IDs and names for tables matching the query. Use the IDs with get_data / get_metadata.

name: get_metadata
description: Fetch the dimension definitions and code lists for a specific e-Stat statistics table (statsDataId). Returns category codes needed to construct filters for get_data. Requires _apiKey.

name: get_data
description: Fetch observations from a stats table. Optionally filter by dimension codes.

name: list_data_catalog
description: Browse the e-Stat high-level data catalog (dataset/table groupings) with an optional free-text filter. Returns catalog entries with dataset IDs, names, and organization metadata. This endpoint is slow at e-Stat and often exceeds its 35s budget, in which case it returns {found:false, reason:"upstream_timeout"}; search_stats answers "which Japanese statistics table covers X" faster. Requires _apiKey.

query.description: Optional free-text filter, Japanese or English

limit.description: Page size, 1-100. Defaults to 20 when omitted, so a bare call is already bounded.

data_type.description: Restrict to one file format: XLS | CSV | PDF | XML | XLS_REP | DB

survey_years.description: Survey period: yyyy, yyyymm, or yyyymm-yyyymm

stats_field.description: Statistical field code, 2 digits (major) or 4 digits (minor)
